data.name: Frydman
data.gender_notes: Frydman is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old High German, Frid means peace or freedom. Man means human. Frydman could symbolize a person who is at peace with their thoughts and beliefs. The name Frydman carries the meaning “Freedom of the mind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frydman usually hope their child will grow to embody freedom of the mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Frydman belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Freedom of the mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Frydman total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
